study type: In vivo experimental animal study (developmental toxicity and toxicokinetic study)
outcome: Skeletal development (including anomalies of the bones)
Tissue distribution of loxoprofen tromethamine (placenta, lung, liver, heart, fetal tissues/organs, amniotic fluid)
cohort: Pregnant rats were intravenously administered loxoprofen tromethamine or sodium cyclophosphamide from gestation days 6-15.
finding: A high dose of loxoprofen tromethamine (10 mg/kg/day) administered to pregnant rats resulted in significant anomalies of the bones in fetuses, while lower doses and other developmental parameters showed no significant differences compared to controls.
birth_weight: Fetal body weight was evaluated as an outcome.
gest_age: Fetuses were observed from administration during Gestation Days 6-15 until euthanasia on Gestation Day 20.
